rows.description: Formerly KrillinAI, VideoTranslation and Dubbing Tool for 120+ Languages. Open-source AI workspace for creators, powered by Codex. Video downloader, video translation, create videos, images, audios, and edits with Agents in one place. For your Social Media like YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, etc.
Download video and audio from 1000+ sites, transcribe locally with speaker labels, and summarize, translate, or chat with your media using your preferred AI provider.
FunASR-powered video transcription, subtitle generation, and LLM-assisted clipping tool with a local Gradio UI.
